key.name: switch-preview
key.description: Whether Preview window (auxiliary text, suggestions) will be shown

key.name: switch-dict
key.description: Whether dictionary suggestions will be shown

key.name: switch-newline
key.description: Whether enter key should commit newline after applying candidate

key.name: lutable-size
key.description: Dictionary suggestion lookup table size

key.name: cboxorient
key.description: Orientation of the desktop (IBus) candidate list: 0 = horizontal, 1 = vertical

key.name: preview-style
key.description: 'classic' shows Avro's own Windows-style Preview Window, 'system' uses the desktop's IBus candidate panel, 'auto' picks classic wherever it can be positioned (X11/XWayland) and the desktop panel on GNOME Wayland

key.name: preview-theme
key.description: Colour theme of the Windows-style Preview Window

key.name: preview-pinned
key.description: Whether the Preview Window stays at a fixed position instead of following the text cursor

key.name: preview-pin-x
key.description: Screen X position of the pinned Preview Window (-1 = not set)

key.name: preview-pin-y
key.description: Screen Y position of the pinned Preview Window (-1 = not set)

key.name: mode-bangla
key.description: Whether Avro is currently in Bangla mode (true) or English passthrough (false)

key.name: bangla-layout
key.description: The IBus keyboard the TopBar switches to for Bangla: 'ibus-avro' (Avro, typing with the layout in "keyboard-layout") or a Bangla system (XKB) layout such as 'xkb:bd::ben' or 'xkb:bd:probhat:ben'

key.name: keyboard-layout
key.description: The layout Avro types with: 'phonetic' (Avro Phonetic) or one of the fixed keyboard layouts of Avro Keyboard: 'avro-easy' (Avro Easy), 'bornona' (Bornona), 'munir-optima' (Munir Optima), 'national' (National (Jatiya)), 'probhat' (Probhat)

key.name: fixed-typing-style
key.summary: Typing style in fixed keyboard layouts
key.description: 'modern': type kar, matra and the short form of vowels always after consonants. 'old': type writer or old ASCII based typing style, with the e, i and oi kars typed before their consonant

key.name: fixed-old-reph
key.summary: Enable "Old Style Reph" (In Modern Typing Style)
key.description: Type reph after the consonant it belongs to; Avro moves it in front of the consonant

key.name: fixed-vowel-forming
key.summary: Enable "Automatic Vowel Forming" (In Modern Typing Style)
key.description: A kar typed where no consonant can take it (at the start of a word, after a vowel or a sign) becomes the full vowel

key.name: fixed-fix-chandra
key.summary: Automatically fix "Chandrabindu" position (In Modern Typing Style)
key.description: A kar typed after chandrabindu is put before it, as Unicode needs

key.name: fixed-numpad-bangla
key.summary: Enable Bangla in NumberPad (In Fixed keyboard Layouts)
key.description: The number pad types Bangla digits in fixed keyboard layouts

key.name: topbar-x
key.description: Screen X position of the TopBar (-1 = default). As in Avro Keyboard, only X is remembered; the bar docks to the top at start-up.

key.name: topbar-skin
key.description: Look of the TopBar: classic (dark), royal (blue), mint (flat green) or light

key.name: topbar-transparent
key.summary: Make TopBar semi transparent when it is inactive
key.description: Fade the TopBar to the transparency level after 5 seconds without mouse activity or mode changes (needs a compositing window manager)

key.name: topbar-transparency-level
key.description: Opacity of the inactive TopBar: 0 = fully transparent, 255 = fully visible

key.name: topbar-x-button
key.description: What a left click on the TopBar power button does: 'menu' (show both options), 'minimize' (jump to the system tray) or 'exit' (close the TopBar). A right click always shows the menu.

key.name: topbar-startup-ui
key.description: How the TopBar starts: 'topbar' (on the desktop), 'tray' (system tray icon) or 'last' (the mode used last time)

key.name: topbar-last-ui
key.description: Internal: whether the TopBar was last shown on the desktop or in the system tray

key.name: topbar-hint-count
key.description: Internal: how many times the first-run "Click here to start Bangla typing" balloon has been shown (at most 2)

key.name: tray-hint-count
key.description: Internal: how many times the "Avro Keyboard is running here" notification has been shown (at most 2)

key.name: topbar-autostart-done
key.summary: TopBar start on login set up
key.description: Internal: whether the TopBar has added itself to the programs that start on login. Like Avro Keyboard, which starts with Windows unless that is turned off, the TopBar does this once, the first time it runs; after that only the user's choice in Preferences counts.

key.name: switch-splash
key.description: Whether to show the Windows-style Avro splash screen when the TopBar starts
